read.en: Rockwell Automation fell 1.4% on Nov 6 to $375.86, trading $370.65–392.54 on volume about 2.2 times its 20-day average. It is below the falling 5-day ($417.5), 10-day ($428.8), 30-day ($432.5) and 100-day ($444.1) averages and the rising 200-day ($427.1). MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 5, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Nov 5 ($452.61), and RSI is 29.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 11月6日下跌 1.4%，收于 $375.86，盘中区间 $370.65–392.54，成交量约为 20 日均量的 2.2 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$417.5）、10 日（$428.8）、30 日（$432.5）和 100 日均线（$444.1）以及上行的 200 日均线（$427.1）下方。MACD 于 11月5日下穿信号线，位于零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 于 11月5日转为看空（$452.61），RSI 为 29。

read.en: An early bounce to $392.54 faded; the $370.65 low dipped under the $375.7 Feb 17 low, but the close held just above it. Resistance is $392.5 (Nov 6 high), then $406.9–412.7 (Sep–Oct lows, Nov 5 high) and $427.1–432.8 (200, 10 and 30-day). Support is $375.7, then $365–370.7 and $347.5. A close above $392.5 would target $407–413; below $370.7, $365.

r.en: Sep 17 low $406.92; Nov 5 high $412.63; Oct 15 low $412.65
